verdict.rationale: A domain registrar's dashboard could plausibly offer AI-generated insights or suggestions, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any in-product AI analysis of the user's domain data. The llms.txt, OpenAPI spec and MCP server probes are agent-access building blocks, not in-product AI insights, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
